stage: flag-gated matched-null after coverage/model screen; no default acceptance

controls.guard-boundary-sampler: Construct the same fresh boundary slots and neighbours, then translate their integer/BV contents by a seeded nonzero exact offset in the null. Same slots, scan, substitution/evaluation and caps. Original candidates are retained. All generated instances still require concrete counterexample evaluation.
controls.array-completion-search: Build the same bounded default pools, then translate their scalar contents by a seeded nonzero exact offset in the null. Same pool lengths, proposal construction, evaluation and certificate paths; mutate before validation only. Unsupported scalar types are marked inactive, never credited.
controls.finite-uf-model-search: Solve the identical bounded finite query in both arms. Rewrite each observed result through the same domain-index selection loop: identity in real, seeded nonidentity domain permutation per observation in null. Identical typed table sizes and independent certificate. Singleton domains cannot be active controls.
controls.datatype-publication-proposals: Construct identical datatype pools and proposal slots. Real uses the original distinct-first/Cartesian values; null scrambles each slot within the same typed pool, with the same proposal cap and acceptance test. It breaks the systematic tuple contents, not the validator. Record early-exit effects separately from the opportunity budget.
controls.numeric-projection-proposals: Build and sort the same numeric argument points. Rewrite every output slot through a cyclic permutation: identity in real, seeded nonidentity rotation in null. Preserve point count, value multiset, interval construction and certificate path. Equal-valued or singleton tables are inactive.

acceptance: No incorrect answer/model; active semantic intervention on at least ten paired actual solver seeds; baseline distribution and off/real/null solved lists; fresh replay. Same intervention slots and caps at a shared entry state must be verified from source and telemetry. Post-intervention termination differences are outcomes, not evidence of equal work. No acceptance from inactive or mismatched controls. Report complete-instruction real/null costs and null/real benefit ratios plus coverage. No speed claim inside +/-5%. Surviving feature must also pass full sample cost, pinned gate/parity, cumulative default production cost and full release suite.
models: Replay every recovered model; finite UF requires explicit nonvacuous finite-domain closure. Partial-consistent and unresolved are not model_ok.
cost: Retired instructions for the whole process; 30 seconds, 8 GiB, two pinned lanes. Instrumentation cost is included and removed for the final production cost check.
